## Response

What is TypeScript?

In short, TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript. This means that any valid JavaScript code is also valid TypeScript code, but TypeScript adds a powerful layer of static typing on top of it.

Think of JavaScript as a powerful but flexible tool where you can accidentally use a hammer to turn a screw. TypeScript is that same tool,
